## Architecture check

Guides applied: [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/ARCHITECTURE.md), [best-practices.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/best-practices.md), [nestjs-patterns.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/nestjs-patterns.md), [api-dtos-and-validation.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/api-dtos-and-validation.md), [security.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/security.md), [testing.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/testing.md), [commits-and-prs.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/commits-and-prs.md), [reviewing.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/reviewing.md), [remarks.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/remarks.md).

1. **[Builders and faker only](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/testing.md#L68)** — [src/modules/auth/oidc/routes/oidc-auth.controller.integration.spec.ts:737](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/0acc2918e5bdfb78f412a7840ab9b95a80d0debd/src/modules/auth/oidc/routes/oidc-auth.controller.integration.spec.ts#L737) — the prior session cookie is minted from a hand-written literal payload that re-types what `oidcAuthPayloadDtoBuilder()` already produces (same `auth_method`, same `faker.string.numeric({ exclude: ['0'] })` for `sub`), which `non-negotiable 6` and R-004 forbid; the sibling unit spec in this same PR uses the builder. **Fix:** add `import { oidcAuthPayloadDtoBuilder } from '@/modules/auth/domain/entities/__tests__/auth-payload-dto.entity.builder';` and replace the literal with `const priorToken = jwtService.sign({ ...oidcAuthPayloadDtoBuilder().build(), exp: priorSessionExp });`.
2. **[PR title](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/commits-and-prs.md#L66)** — PR title — `fix: Session duration step up` has a capitalised, non-imperative noun-phrase description, and squash-merge makes it the permanent commit subject on `main`. **Fix:** retitle to `fix(auth): keep the prior session expiry on step-up`.

**Verdict:** ❌ 2 finding(s)
